title: Design System: Facetmark tonal collection workbench

motion.name: collection-reflow
motion.purpose: Motion layout position; disabled with reduced motion.

motion.name: overlay-exit

motion.purpose: Motion local folder/model picker feedback; review together with the global CSS press rule.

motion.name: native-menu

motion.name: navigation-drawer
motion.purpose: CSS narrow-screen directory drawer.

motion.name: theme-reveal

motion.name: reader-tab-marker
motion.purpose: GSAP marker x/width; immediate with reduced motion.

motion.name: reader-focus
motion.purpose: GSAP focus translation with interruptible cleanup.

motion.name: reader-presence
motion.purpose: Motion with Radix Dialog; focus containment and return remain.

motion.name: reading-capsule
motion.purpose: Motion reader capsule entry; immediate with reduced motion.

motion.name: chapter-label
motion.purpose: Motion real-heading label; immediate with reduced motion.

motion.name: reading-progress
motion.purpose: Motion measured article scroll; direct value with reduced motion.

motion.name: outline-plane
motion.value: spring: stiffness 380, damping 32, mass .65; rotation clamped to +/-18deg
motion.purpose: Motion plane follows measured active heading; direct placement with reduced motion.

material.name: tonal-workspace
material.value: desk and rail surfaces; canvas content; violet selection

material.name: reading-glass
material.purpose: Bounded capsule with opaque fallback and reduced-transparency override.

evidence.verification: A complete final replacement verification set and fresh capture/interaction review remain pending. Run links record the initial source snapshot; use PR checks for current source and outcomes.
evidence.specimens: Source-derived HTML/CSS with synthetic content. Native CSS states are included; runtime Motion/GSAP/WAAPI, data and navigation are not implemented or verified by these examples.
evidence.referenceAuthority: Structural and behavioral references, not user-approved Facetmark mockups or capture evidence.
evidence.tonalRamps: Synthetic eight-step OKLCH preview ramps derived from frontmatter hex values; alpha preserved; not additional runtime tokens.

narrative.overview:
Facetmark uses a stable application rail, a separate collection directory and a flexible content area. Pale lavender surfaces, white content cards, deep plum text and violet selection create a Material-inspired hierarchy. Bundled Inter and Noto Sans SC keep Latin and Chinese text consistent across desktop and Web.

The 2026-10-19 replacement changes composition, typography, component shape and interaction feedback together. It supersedes the rejected 10/18 blue-grey system. Navigation, classification, settings tabs, content changes and overlays now show visible continuity; original links, processing scope and saved task state retain their independent semantics. The reference projects informed the implementation, not a user-approved pixel comp.
keyCharacteristics: Stable application navigation and a separate searchable collection directory.
Tonal surfaces with violet selected state and readable plum text.
Local Latin and Chinese variable fonts; compact titles and visible summaries.
Small rounded controls, rounded cards and larger modal surfaces.
Immediate actions with bounded press, ink, selection and content feedback.
Live reduced-motion handling, keyboard access and truthful application state.

rules.name: The Tonal Selection Rule.
rules.body: Keep ordinary content on its canvas. Selection is expressed through a moving tonal surface, an explicit mark or an accent boundary; text and semantics must identify the same selected item.

rules.name: The Shared Collection Scale Rule.
rules.body: Card/list switching preserves the title and summary hierarchy. Expansion depends on measured clipping, not a guessed character count; smaller metadata must not replace the visible summary.

rules.name: The Stable Target Rule.
rules.body: Feedback may animate a paint layer, indicator or content container, but focus, selection and data changes never wait for animation. Closing overlays become inert and noninteractive while their visual exit completes.

dos: Do keep the navigation rail, directory and content responsibilities distinct.
Do use the bundled Latin and Chinese font families and shared collection scale.
Do retain explicit pressed/current/selected semantics beside visual feedback.
Do preserve full directory pagination, exact folder choice and separate search drafts.
Do keep original links, checkboxes, editing and optional preview independent.
Do preserve processing consent, exact task snapshots and truthful recovery state.
Do keep animations interruptible and respect the live reduced-motion preference.
Do verify both static composition and actual click sequences in GitHub Actions.
donts: Don't restore the rejected 10/18 composition, blue-grey palette or system-font-only direction.
Don't apply the reader's pill shape to every navigation, input and action.
Don't make content, focus or data updates wait for a decorative transition.
Don't let CSS, GSAP, Motion or WAAPI own the same animated property on the same element.
Don't broaden a task-specific retry or mistake model discovery for successful access.
Don't present reference screenshots, source specimens or historical runs as current visual approval.
